name: Palencia (Spain)
description: Purple field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Palencia (quartered, crosses and castles on blue and red).
history: The flag of the city of Palencia is purple, a consequence of the error of the erudite tradition of the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries regarding the degradation of the natural gules or crimson dyes of the banner of Castile.

features.role: Palencia arms — quartered, crosses and castles on blue and red
